definitions.explanation: The surgical removal or deactivation of reproductive organs in an animal or, historically, in a person. In modern Japanese, most commonly used in the context of pet care and livestock management.
Used figuratively to describe stripping someone or something of power, influence, or vitality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{去勢|きょせい}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けさせた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

{去勢|きょせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Neutered dogs often become calmer in temperament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野良猫|のらねこ}→野良猫：14440_noraneko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{去勢|きょせい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Neutering activities are being conducted in the community to prevent the increase of stray cats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去勢|きょせい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}した→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition criticized the bill, saying it would emasculate the parliament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去勢|きょせい}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The media must not be rendered powerless by regulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去勢|きょせい}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧になってしまった。
examples.english: The spirit of reform was emasculated, and it became a system in name only.

notes:
A compound of {去|きょ} (remove, get rid of) and {勢|せい} (vigor, vitality — here referring to reproductive power). The word can function as a noun or as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

In modern usage, sense 1 (neutering/spaying) is by far the most common, especially in the context of pet ownership. Japanese veterinary clinics routinely recommend {去勢|きょせい}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ for male animals; the equivalent procedure for female animals is technically {避妊|ひにん}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (spaying), though {去勢|きょせい} is sometimes used loosely for both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {去勢|きょせい}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: neutering surgery
- {去勢|きょせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to neuter, to castrate
- {去勢|きょせい}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already neutered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {避妊|ひにん}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: spaying (for female animals) — the female-specific equivalent
- ⟦{虚勢|きょせい}→虚勢：09163_kyosei⟧: bluff, bravado — a homophone with completely different meaning; uses {虚|きょ} (empty) instead of {去|きょ} (remove)
